estadoFrase.fresco: Your legs are rested. Form drops if this lasts.
estadoFrase.optimo: Form and freshness in balance. A good moment to push.
estadoFrase.productivo: Form is rising and fatigue is under control. Keep going.
estadoFrase.cargado: Fatigue has built up. Look after sleep and easy sessions.
estadoFrase.riesgo: The load rose quickly. Ease off for a few days.

carrera.sub: The date and the plan up to the start
carrera.vacioCuerpo: Choose a race and a date. The system lays out the weeks up to the start.
carrera.borrarMensaje: The whole plan is deleted. Your workouts are not touched.
carrera.plazoCorto: Compressed plan: there were fewer than six weeks. The goal is to arrive healthy.
carrera.descargaPista: Recovery: an easy week to absorb the work.
carrera.cumplidaCuerpo: Race done. Choose the next one.

hoja.horasAyuda: The ones you can sustain, not the ones you would like.

hoja.errorFechaLejos: Choose a date within two years at most.

hoja.previa_other: {{count}} weeks of plan, with a maximum of {{horas}} h per week.

progreso.vacioCuerpo: Log your first workout. The curve starts with it.
progreso.graficaA11y: Form and fatigue curve. Today: form {{ctl}}, fatigue {{atl}}, freshness {{tsb}}.
progreso.orientativo: Guide values to organise training. They are not a diagnosis.
progreso.volumenA11y: Volume over the last eight weeks. This week: {{duracion}}.
progreso.recordsVacio: No marks yet. The first comes with your next measured workout.
progreso.recordsError: Records could not be calculated. Swipe to try again.

fasePista.base: Base: easy volume to build the engine.
fasePista.construccion: Build: the load rises little by little.
fasePista.pico: Peak: the highest load before coming down.
fasePista.afinado: Taper: you cut volume to arrive fresh.

detalle.seriesCalma: Warm up well and do intervals with full recovery. Easy cool-down.
detalle.progresiones: Comfortable pace and a few short strides at the end.
detalle.conversacionHoy: Conversational pace. Nothing to prove today.
detalle.fuerza: Squat, Romanian deadlift, calf and core. Not to failure.
detalle.tiradaEnsayo: Comfortable pace from start to finish. Rehearse race drink and food.
detalle.tecnicaNatacion: Short sets with rest. Mind your position and breathing.
detalle.natacionAerobica: Long blocks at a steady pace, sighting every few strokes.
detalle.series: Warm up well and do intervals with full recovery.
detalle.comodo: Comfortable pace from start to finish.
detalle.bloquesBici: Blocks at race pace with easy recovery between them.
detalle.biciAerobica: High cadence and a smooth pedal stroke.
detalle.salidaBici: Comfortable pace. Rehearse race drink and food.
detalle.transiciones: Repeat wetsuit to bike and bike to shoes until it happens without thinking.
detalle.activacion: Very short, with three or four accelerations. Get your gear and food ready.
detalle.rodajeCorto: Short, with your head on the race.
detalle.biciCorta: Check the bike just as you will race it.
detalle.natacionCorta: Easy, with a few efforts at race pace.
detalle.prueba: Go at your own pace and eat as rehearsed.
detalle.brick: {{bici}} min on the bike and, without a break, {{pie}} min running. Your legs have to learn the switch.
